items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Benny Payne... was in Cab Calloway's band at that time, and was his pianist, you know.

ctx.x: Huh. Maybe that's it. He was on the bill.

Yes, he was on the bill. This is when he did It Ain't Necessarily So and, of course, Minnie the Moocher, that was the theme song of his big band in those days. And I think how that came about, you know, he traveled -- the past few years he's been traveling with the Globetrotters, the famous basketball team, and during the intermissions, he's been doing the talking and the singing and whatnot. Well, here a few years (inaudible) back -- I had the pleasure of doing this on -- I think I was in Minneapolis. And he was…
